title: PulsePire x32
description: This texture pack made only for Bedwars i recomended use with (Faithful 32x) and (SmallHelditems)
body:
## PulsePire x32

*PulsePire* is made exculsively for *Bedwars* players

for best experience, i recommended using this pack alongside *Faithful 32x* and *Smallhelditems 1.8.9*

## this Texture adds

here is what pack currently features-
*Neon Weapons*- Swords,pickaxes and axes have *minimalistic* texture and *neon outline*

*Neon ingots*- minimalistic ingots and with neon outline *iron ingot*, *gold ingot*, *diamond ingot*, *emerald ingot*

*Wools*-Bright wools with neon outline and not ordinary, *Colors of wools*-*White, Red ,Blue ,Yellow ,Pink ,Green ,Lime ,cyan ,Light blue ,gray , *10 colors of Wools*

And with transparent GUI for Bedwars (not ready yet)

## Coming soon

*GUI textures* for *Bedwars*

*Neon items* for *bedwars*

*Neon armors*

## Mini information
And this pack author tried do every pixels perefect with reslotion with *32x32*
